data.title: Unit 8: Matter and changing matter
Matter and particles
data.heading: Melting
data.text: Melting ice changes it from solid to liquid.
When heat is applied to a solid, the molecules in the solid get more energy and start to move..
Ice or solid water melts at 0˚C. Iron requires more than 1500˚C to melt.
Wood is a bad conductor of heat and will burn and not melt when heated.
